both.q: Does it work for sales and rentals at the same time?
both.a: Yes. Both operations live in the same system: sales with offers and commission, and holiday rentals with availability, seasonal rates, dated bookings and payments.

migration.q: How long does the migration take?
migration.a: It depends on how much data you have and what format it's in. We look at your case in the demo and give you a specific date.

address.a: Your website lives on a Tivvo subdomain with your agency's name. We don't offer custom domains yet.

privacy.q: Is my data mixed with other agencies' data?
privacy.a: No. Each agency works in its own space and only its team can see its properties, clients and bookings.

users.q: How many users can I have?
users.a: One on the Free plan. Pro and Enterprise have no limit: bring your whole team.

site.q: Can I customise my agency's website?
site.a: Yes. You choose a template, colours and typefaces, and add your own blocks such as location, promotions, featured properties, destinations, text and calls to action. You see the result on desktop, tablet and mobile before publishing.

team.q: What does each person on my team see?
team.a: Agents see their properties, clients, offers and bookings, plus unassigned inquiries. Owners and administrators see everything and can reassign.

owner.q: What does the owner see in their portal?
owner.a: Their properties, bookings and payments, with what was collected, the payouts and the balance. The agency's commission stays hidden unless you decide to show it.
